text:
Jamie: Morning — quick async standup. What I did: drained 3 nodes in eu-west-1 for kernel upgrade, validated prewarm smoke, patched autoscaler to ignore pending pods. Blockers: noticed uneven lane allocation — amphora lane is skewed to p3.8s in ams1, causing ~8% tail latency bump. Today: working on lane-rebalance PR #4821, will open a QA run and coordinate prewarm. cc @Chen @Maria

Chen: saw the bump, logs point to spot evictions + scheduler not respecting maxBurst. I can try a hotfix in the autoscaler branch; will run a canary in ap-southeast-1 later today.

Maria: FYI capacity request submitted to cloud-ops: ticket CLOU-1290, asking for +6 GPUs in ams1 for our peak windows. ETA ~24h.

infra-bot: [deploy] canary-autoscaler v2.3 deployed to apac at 2024-09-15T09:23Z :white_check_mark:

Jamie: pinging @Arian for quota check — are we cleared to request reserved capacity if cloud-ops says no?

Arian: yes we can request Dedicated as fallback but need finance signoff for >$15k/mo. I can start the approval thread if needed.

Chen: quick snippet I ran:
```
kubectl get nodes -l lane=amphora -o wide
# showed 12 nodes, 3 drained, 9 active
```

Maria: short-term mitigation: reduce lane weight for amphora by 20% in the routing table, should lower pressure. I'll apply in 10m and monitor.

Jamie: thanks. Blockers: will need someone to merge #4821 after tests — @Chen can you review? small change in scheduler heuristics.

Chen: will review in 30m.

Arian: tracking: if finance blocks reserved capacity, we fallback to burst in us-east-1 (spot). I'll prep the routing policy and cost estimate.

Jamie: ok. I'll post a follow-up if latency doesn't drop after Maria's change. Otherwise tomorrow morning I'll run a full regen of KV caches to avoid a warmup thundering herd.

Maria: noted. Dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/infra/amphora-lane?range=1h

infra-bot: incident-note created INC-2024-342: amphora lane latency spike. Assigned to Jamie, Chen.

Chen: quick heads-up: PR #4821 includes a fallback to a quantized model for amphora if queue_depth > 300.

Jamie: good. End of thread.
